implementation.action: Replay the running prefixes in order. For a planned look use the already verified tg128 values of that pair only. Recompute ratio, sample deviations, band, and stop from the pinned look implementation's semantics, then evaluate the schedule: answer if lower edge >1.00; futility if upper edge <0.95; otherwise continue. Apply thresholds before display rounding and validate exact emitted fields and final summary fields derivable from the original rows. Preserve wall_s as producer-reported with window sanity checks; original T0 integer is not a field in RUN. Keep paired flip counts and operational outcomes scoped; summary and stop labels alone are insufficient.

implementation.action: Project only after whole-run acceptance. Emit per-arm measured PP/TG observations using validated arm vectors, exact scored independent launch count (2 or 3), units tokens/s and higher_better. Preserve original vector, verified operational looks and paired results in scoped evidence. If projecting a scoped paired-quality observation, count 24 pairs, not 48 independent items, and express both model identities explicitly. Use stable run-and-metric identities and original result digest/locator. Leave protocol_id empty unless the experiment had an applicable formally declared protocol at acquisition. The official exploratory pilot label supplies no protocol by itself. Validate grade Judged/Located for these observations through shared grade only; no new ladder or promotion.
